Appellant has filed this criminal appeal under Section 14(A)(2) of the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.321/2024 registered at P.S. Nagda, District Ujjain (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376 of IPC and Section 3(1)(W-II), 3(2)(v) of SC/ST (PA) Act.

sentences.text: Appellant is in jail since 22.06.2024.
2. Allegation against the appellant is that of commission of rape with the prosecutrix.
3. Learned counsel for the appellant submit that the appellant is innocent person and has been falsely implicated in this offence.

Prosecutrix is a major lady and as per her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, she was well acquainted with the appellant and she herself has gone with him, thereafter the appellant took her to the field and committed rape with her.
Counsel further submitted that the said intercourse was committed with consent, but when the family members of the prosecutrix came in between, this FIR has been lodged.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:35286 2 CRA-13082-2024

Earlier appeal was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to renew the prayer after completion of two months in custody,
now the aforesaid period is over, hence the present appeal.
Appellant is in custody since 22.06.2024.

sentences.text: Conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time, hence, counsel prayed that the appellant be enlarged on bail.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the appeal and prays for its rejection.

5. Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case diary.
6.
Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature and gravity of the allegation, so also the custody period, I deem it proper to release the appellant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, the appeals are allowed.

7. It is directed that appellant be released on bail on his/her furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

The appellant shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
